You'll work on a live product, so you'll see your code in production and you'll be the one called when something breaks - we want someone who fixes the problem in front of them, then goes back and fixes why it happened. Our engineering team is in India and our stakeholders are in the US, so you'll work across both and talk to the people who make product decisions every day. The scope is wide on purpose: you'll start with the backend, and over time you can grow into platform reliability, data work, or product decisions if that's where your interest goes. ## What You'll Do - **Own backend services:** Own backend services in Python and Django REST Framework from design through production, and design new features with the technical decisions written up, including what you chose not to do and why. - **Work with PostgreSQL:** Model data, dig into slow queries, pick sensible indexes, and run safe migrations on tables that are already in use. - **Run services on AWS:** Deploy and run our services on AWS, keeping an eye on how they behave under load. - **Build observability:** Add tracing, metrics, and logs so we can see problems before customers report them. - **Own incidents:** Lead root-cause analysis on incidents, then automate the detection or fix so the same issue doesn't come back. - **Partner with US stakeholders:** Clarify requirements, agree on priorities, and explain trade-offs with US stakeholders. ## What You'll Need - **Backend:** 2+ years of backend work, comfortable with Python and Django REST Framework (viewsets, serializers, auth and permissions, background jobs) and keeping service code tidy. - **PostgreSQL:** You can model data, find out why a query is slow using EXPLAIN ANALYZE, pick sensible indexes, and run migrations safely on a live database. - **AWS:** You've deployed and run real services, with experience across some of ECS, Lambda, or EC2, S3, RDS, SQS/SNS, IAM, and CI/CD pipelines. - **Tracing & observability:** Hands-on with distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry, X-Ray, or similar), structured logs, and dashboards (CloudWatch, Grafana, Datadog, or similar), and able to set alerts that people actually act on. - **Troubleshooting:** You work through problems step by step - form a guess, check it with data, fix the immediate issue, then remove the cause (bonus if you've written scripts or automation that catch problems early). - **Architecture & communication:** You can compare two approaches on cost, reliability, and team effort and write the decision down so others can follow it, explain a technical idea to someone who isn't an engineer, say when you disagree, and follow up on what you promised. ## Compensation and Benefits - **Compensation:** Top of market salary + bonuses and equity - **Time off:** 49 days paid time off - **Benefits:** PTO, full benefits, retirement and wellness plans - **Growth:** Professional development support, remote workspace setup bonus - **Team building:** Annual company offsites in exciting locations around the world ## Location This role is based in India (remote), working PST / CST hours to overlap with US stakeholders. Certa is a remote-first company and we hire globally. We believe strongly in each team member working from the location that they choose. Should Certers wish to meet and work in person, they have 3 lively office locations they can travel to: - London - San Francisco - Jaipur The perfect place for Certers to collaborate, co-work, and have face-to-face meetings. ## Why Certa - **Category leadership.** Certa was named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Third-Party Risk Management Tools - recognition that we're defining the category, not following it. - **Industry recognition.** We've been honored across the analyst and awards landscape, including Top Tech and Customer Value distinctions in The Hackett Group's 2026 Risk Management SolutionMap, the ProcureTech100 (Advanced AI and Risk Management categories), and Best Overall eProcurement Software in the FinTech Breakthrough Awards. - **A top place to work.** Certa was named one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers in the US. We're a fast-growing company where you'll wear many hats, ship quickly, and shape decisions that matter. - **Real scale with strong backing.** We've processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries. We're well-funded by leading investors including Fin Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Point72 Ventures, on the back of an oversubscribed Series B, headed towards Series C. We're excited to meet you! Certa celebrates difference. Get to Know Us
Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 
We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.
 
What You'll Do
• 
Investigate complex failures across the entire stack. A single case might take you from Kubernetes pod scheduling, through container networking, into cloud IAM permissions, and into our application logs in Datadog. You own the investigation end to end.
• 
Be the technical bridge between customers and engineering. You'll translate customer-reported symptoms into actionable bug reports with reproduction steps, logs, and root cause hypotheses. When engineering ships a fix, you verify it actually solves the problem in the customer's environment.
• 
Build tooling and automation. If you're doing something manually more than twice, you build a tool. We need someone who writes Python scripts, builds internal dashboards, automates data collection from Zendesk and Jira, and creates runbooks that make the whole team more effective.
• 
Drive systemic improvements. You'll spot patterns across tickets that point to product gaps, documentation holes, or infrastructure reliability issues. You bring the data, make the case, and work with engineering and product to fix the root cause, not just the symptom.
• 
Go deep on web application security. Our platform now does web app pentesting. You need to understand common vulnerability classes (OWASP top 10), how web scanners work, and how to explain findings and their implications to customers who range from security experts to IT generalists.
• 
Mentor the team and raise the technical bar. You'll help junior and senior engineers develop their troubleshooting skills, create training content, and establish patterns for how the team approaches complex investigations.
What We're Looking For
Must have:
• 
8+ years of hands-on technical experience. The title on your resume matters less than what you've actually done. We'll take an SRE who built incident response tooling, a backend developer who ran production infrastructure, or a support engineer who can write real code and read Terraform.
• 
Strong Linux fundamentals. You're comfortable on a command line, can troubleshoot a hung process on RHEL, understand SELinux, and don't need a GUI to be productive.
• 
Container and Kubernetes experience. You've deployed and troubleshot containerized workloads. You know the difference between a CrashLoopBackOff and an ImagePullBackOff and what to do about each.
• 
Cloud platform experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP). You understand IAM, networking (VPCs, security groups, firewalls), and have worked with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation) -- not just reading plans, but writing and debugging them when provisioning fails.
• 
GraphQL and web application fluency. Our API is GraphQL. You can trace a request from a React frontend through the GraphQL layer to the backend, interpret query/mutation responses (including partial errors in a 200), and debug auth flows, CORS issues, and network failures using browser dev tools.
• 
Database fundamentals. You can write SQL to investigate data issues, understand relational and NoSQL concepts, and ideally have exposure to graph databases -- our product maps attack paths and relationships that are naturally graph-shaped.
• 
Scripting ability in Python and Bash. You've built automation that other people actually use, not just one-off scripts for yourself.
• 
Observability tool experience (Datadog preferred). You can search logs, build queries, read traces, and correlate signals across services to find where something broke.

ABOUT COG CULTURE
Cog Culture is not your typical advertising agency. Shocking, we know — most agencies say exactly that, right before unveiling a logo in three shades of blue and calling it "a bold new direction."

But stay with us.

We're an award-winning, full-service marketing communications agency with a decade and a half of experience building brand narratives that actually move people — not just move the goalposts, the timeline, and eventually the blame. What sets us apart isn't the trophy shelf. It's what's running underneath it.

We're AI-native — and we mean that the way a fish means water, not the way a corporation means "digital transformation." Artificial intelligence isn't a tool we picked up; it's the lens through which we think, build, and create. GenAI content workflows, intelligent campaign analytics, automation that earns its keep — at Cog Culture, AI isn't the support act. It's the headliner, the venue, and the one who actually read the brief.

A decade and a half of building brands, and we still had the audacity to think: what if we also built the platform the industry actually needs? So we are. A B2B SaaS product purpose-built for marketing and advertising — packaging the intelligence, tools, and workflows we've developed in-house, and putting them in the hands of brands and agencies at scale.

This is a 0-to-1 build. We don't need someone to warm the seat. We need an Associate Product Manager who treats ambiguity like a creative brief — and ships.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an Associate Product Manager — SaaS who will lead the strategy, development, and scaling of SaaS-based products that power the agency’s advertising, marketing, and analytics capabilities. This role bridges business, technology, and creative teams, driving product-led innovation that enhances client outcomes, operational efficiency, and revenue growth.

The ideal candidate is someone who understands both the product craft and the marketing technology landscape — someone who can think in user journeys and system architectures, work with engineers and creatives in the same day, and drive a product from idea to impact without losing momentum.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Product Strategy & Vision
– Define and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for SaaS products aligned with agency growth goals
– Identify and build innovative ad-tech and mar-tech solutions, including AI, analytics, automation, and campaign management platforms
– Own the end-to-end product lifecycle — from ideation and MVP through to launch and continuous improvement 

AI & Intelligent Product Development
– Lead product initiatives involving NLP, Generative AI, Transformer architectures, LLMs, embeddings, vector search, and end-to-end RAG pipelines
– Work with AI/ML frameworks and orchestration tools including PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, and LlamaIndex
– Drive integration with vector databases and search infrastructure such as Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone, and Weaviate, along with distributed data stores like PostgreSQL or Cassandra

Platform & Infrastructure Collaboration
– Partner closely with engineering on MLOps and production requirements — model deployment, monitoring, CI/CD pipelines, feature stores, and enterprise-grade scalability
– Work across cloud-native infrastructure decisions involving Docker, Kubernetes, and major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

Execution & Stakeholder Management
– Write clear PRDs, manage the product backlog, and run Agile/Scrum ceremonies with the engineering team
– Collaborate with business, creative, and client teams to translate real-world needs into product decisions
– Track product performance, define success metrics, and iterate based on data and user feedback

SKILLS & REQUIREMENTS
Must-Have
– 1-3 years of experience in SaaS product management, preferably in ad-tech, mar-tech, or digital platforms
– Proven ability to build and scale B2B SaaS products in Agile environments
– Strong understanding of advertising agency workflows, media operations, analytics, and campaign management
– Hands-on experience with product roadmaps, PRDs, backlog management, and Agile/Scrum methodologies
– Familiarity with cloud-based SaaS architecture, APIs, data platforms, automation tools, and dashboards
– Exposure to AI-driven products, data analytics, and CRM/CDP platforms
– Strategic, execution-focused mindset with strong stakeholder management and communication skills
– Customer-centric, entrepreneurial approach with high ownership and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
